name: Takasu Ryuuji
source: Main protagonist of the story and a student of class 2-C. Due to heredity, his sanpaku eyes make him look like an intimidating delinquent and causes many misunderstandings. He lives in a fatherless family, his father having left before Ryuuji was born, with just his mother. Due to this, Ryuuji has learned to be self-sufficient. He excels at cooking and everything related to housekeeping, to the point of feeling compelled to clean up messes he can find, and also excels at sewing.
